Tip: Time.

Ppl often underestimate just how much time it takes to foster shared understanding. I’ve seen a leadership team barely, barely scratch the surface...after 24hrs/3 days, and prod teams take two weeks just to get their bearings around a new initiative.

This is “work”

“Our weekly all-hands probably cost us $60-80k in opportunity costs. We sit and talk about wins. Yet we can’t approve the $100k in tooling to move beyond success theater.”
